question: What did the first International Crimes Tribunal verdict, delivered on 21 January 2013, show about the tribunal?

options.text: That it had moved from institutional setup to concrete sentencing
That it had been wound up after its first case
That it had yet to hear any case

explanation: The Abul Kalam Azad verdict showed the tribunal had moved from institutional setup to concrete sentencing, making the justice process newly visible in public life.
